description: Install with --unified-skills and ask Claude Code, headlessly and without tools, which pan- skills it can see; the answer measures whether the shared .agents/skills tree is discovered.
why: ADR-0028's default-on gate (P4) and the README's claim that the unified tree is read natively were never live-measured on Claude Code. Unified skill names are `pan-<command>` (no colon); the proprietary commands are `/pan:<command>`, so a colon-free name in the answer can only have come from the shared tree.

steps.why: The installer's contract: the unified tree exists before the question is asked.

steps.prompt: Without using any tools, list the names of the skills currently available to you whose names begin with pan- (with a hyphen, not a colon), one per line, exactly as they are spelled. Then print the single word DONE on its own line.
steps.why: If Claude Code loads .agents/skills, pan-help appears; if only .claude/commands/pan is loaded, the answer holds /pan:help forms and the assertion fails — that failure is the measurement ADR-0028 has been waiting for.
